thread: vivian: opened a docs PR with a migration guide + new SDK snippet. CI failing: linkcheck + vale + mdspell. can anyone help triage fast? docs-ci-bot: Running checks for PR #3217: linkcheck, vale, mdspell, markdownlint, site-preview. carlos: linkcheck shows a 404 for internal anchor `#install-onprem` referenced from getting-started.md. meera: i think head was renamed to `Installing on-premises` so the generated anchor is `installing-on-premises` not `install-onprem`. vivian: thanks, i'll update the link. also vale flagged passive voice in the advisory section: "We suggest pinning model versions." meera: change to imperative: `Pin model versions to ensure stable inference.` short and clear. vivian: updated wording and patched the link to `#installing-on-premises`. pushing now. docs-ci-bot: mdspell: found `enviroment` in sdk/usage.md -> suggestion: `environment`. vivian: fixed typo and pushed. docs-ci-bot: Re-running checks after commits... docs-ci-bot: linkcheck: still failing - missing anchor `#onprem-install` referenced from index.md meera: hmm older docs still refer to `#onprem-install`. two options: add an HTML anchor alias in migration.md like `` beneath the header, or update all cross-doc links. which is faster? carlos: alias is fastest for the release window, but we should prefer fixing links in follow-up to avoid accumulating aliases. vivian: i'll add the alias under the H1 and open an issue to sweep old links. pushing alias now: `` right after the heading. docs-ci-bot: markdownlint warns MD013 for a long inline curl example in migration.md (>120 chars). meera: split the curl command across lines inside a fenced block, and add a brief comment line to explain each flag. small edit, pushing. docs-ci-bot: vale still flags PR-VOICE: "We recommend that you enable KMS for keys." carlos: prefer active: `Enable KMS-backed keys for private deployments.` vivian: changed and pushed. docs-ci-bot: All checks passed. Preview built at https://deploy-preview-3217.docs.redwood.ai/ please sanity check anchors and SDK snippet formatting. meera: preview looks good. alias anchor works and the snippet highlights fine. one small nit: mobile code block scroll is chunky but not a blocker. vivian: is this blocking the release? we have a merge window at 14:00 PT. carlos: it's on the release list; if we merge now it will be included. can one reviewer approve? meera: approving. :+1: carlos: approved as well. vivian: merging now. /merge deploy-bot: Merge queued. Starting post-merge preview deploy. deploy-bot: Preview deployed at https://deploy-preview-3217.docs.redwood.ai/ please sanity-check the on-prem anchors. vivian: checked preview; anchors resolve and SDK snippet renders in both themes. carlos: follow-up: i don't like relying on alias hacks. can we add a small CI job that normalizes header text using the same rules as the static site generator and verifies internal anchors exist before merging? meera: agree. i'll draft a tiny script (node/python) that computes the site anchor for a header and validates links referenced in markdown. we can run it as part of linkcheck. vivian: awesome. can you open an issue and tag eng-infra/ci so they can help with CI integration? carlos: done: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/561 brief proposal attached. meera: i'll include test cases (headers with parentheses, em-dashes, and punctuation) so we mirror the generator exactly. vivian: thanks all for the quick turnaround :rocket:
